Fix the two remaining registry validation errors described below, then confirm 'ai-company doctor fix' and 'ai-company agents list' both run clean with no errors, and 'pytest -q' still passes with no regressions. Commit with a clear message referencing this fix.
name: Fix registry validation errors (department name/ID mismatch + CEO reports_to)
description: Two remaining CompanyRegistry validation issues after the executives/departments partitioning bug was fixed in loader.py and parser.py. Issue 1: human_ceo's reports_to references 'board_chair' (a board member) instead of an executive ID or the literal string 'board' — validator.py _check_executives rejects this. Fix: change human_ceo's reports_to in company-registry.yaml from 'board_chair' to 'board'. Issue 2: ~100 specialist entries have a department field using a display name (e.g. 'Finance', 'Technology', 'AI Research') while departments.yaml defines departments by lowercase snake_case id (e.g. 'finance', 'technology', 'ai_research') — validator.py _check_specialists compares directly against IDs, so every specialist fails. Separately, some specialists (e.g. reporting to lead_frontend, ai_safety_lead, test_engineering_lead, security_compliance_lead) report_to other specialists rather than executives, which _check_specialists doesn't currently allow. Preferred fix: update _check_specialists in validator.py so department matching accepts either the department id or its display name (case-insensitive, built from both d.id and d.name across r.departments), and so reports_to is checked against the union of executive IDs and specialist IDs rather than executives alone.
